Dear Madam
I am much obliged for your gift of the ‘Names on the Gates of Pearl’[^1] - I am already a great admirer of it, and introduced it to [Miss Mackenzie](/person/930) (the sister of the late [Bishop of Zululand](/person/929) and editor of the [Net](/periodical/94), and she has sent it to some of her Missionary friends I will do what more I can for I am sure it ought to be known.

yours truly

C M Yonge
